integrity: The global inequality is proved by algebraic positivity and a gradient bound. Reproducible rational computations are checked separately; independent scientific assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The constant 3/32 is a certified upper bound, not proven exactly optimal; the optimal one-vertex coefficient lies between 567/4 - 2043 sqrt(13)/52 and 3/32. The three-vertex coefficient 9/32 is not claimed optimal.
title: A near-sharp vertex-perturbation bound for planar simplex strength
